lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND — the protocol's Area 25 entry states only that a missing nursing/functional/social assessment results in disallowance; no observation/look-back window is stated for this finding. The protocol does state that these findings apply to service dates prior to 03/01/2015 (page header: "For Service Dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015"), which is an applicability period, not an assessor look-back window.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the nursing/functional/social assessment is missing, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the nursing/functional/social assessment is missing, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: This finding applies only to service dates prior to 03/01/2015; it was phased out per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3.

source.quote:
For Services Dates Prior to 03/01/2015
Findings below phased out as per NYS DOH Medicaid Update, February 2013, Vol. 29, No. 3

federal.criterion: A nursing/functional/social assessment must be present in the record for the claim under review; its absence results in disallowance.

source.quote: If the nursing/functional/social assessment is missing, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: Stated as the OMIG Audit Criteria for Area 25.

state_deltas.delta: This entire protocol is a New York State (OMIG) document; Area 25 disallows claims when the nursing/functional/social assessment is missing, with regulatory references 10 NYCRR § 766.6(a)(3); For Services 05/25/18 and After: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(f) and (g); For Services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(e) and (f).

source.quote:
Regulatory References 10 NYCRR § 766.6(a)(3)
For Services 05/25/18 and After: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(f) and (g)
For Services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(e) and (f)

case_mix_relevance.notes: The Area 25 entry does not tie the nursing/functional/social assessment to a payment or case-mix classification. (Rate/case-mix consequences appear in other areas of the protocol, e.g. Areas 13 and 29, not in Area 25.)

conflicts.topic: Applicability date range printed for the pages containing Area 25 versus the document's overall service-date range

positions.claim: The document overall covers service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.
The page containing Area 25 is headed for service dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015, and the findings on it are stated to be phased out for service dates prior to 03/01/2015.

conflicts.resolution: Document itself resolves: the page-level heading and the "For Services Dates Prior to 03/01/2015" banner narrow Area 25 to service dates 01/01/2013 through 02/28/2015 within the broader protocol.
